recommendation: Keep the commit as-is; it completes the Published correction with a narrow build-scope source fix and does not require broader CQL media type policy work.
issue_request: FHIR-35981 was Published/Persuasive for R5 and asked that text/cql uses in the Clinical Reasoning Using Expressions topic be changed to text/cql-expression or text/cql-identifier where appropriate.
initial_application: PR 1801, merged as 1053365100b489e63db045d70bcbf378cdc3c30f from implementation commit c3a6925d119e8f0c2360c819b1e3ddcd7b772b04, fixed several examples but left later qualified XML and JSON named-expression examples using text/cql.
additional_context: publish.ini actively includes clinicalreasoning-topics-using-expressions.html. The ExpressionLanguage value set and metadatatypes narrative define text/cql-identifier for CQL identifiers and text/cql-expression for inline CQL expressions. Later same-page changes for FHIR-49976 and FHIR-53080 added guidance and backwards-compatibility text but did not supersede the original media type correction. A 2024 Zulip discussion clarified that text/cql-identifier covers valid identifiers and qualified identifiers.
reconciliation: Changed source/clinicalreasoning-topics-using-expressions.html so the qualified RiskAssessmentScore XML and JSON examples use text/cql-identifier. Left the generic text/cql list entry and backwards-compatibility note unchanged because they describe a still-supported media type rather than stale example usage.
